get_thread_pool_executor: get a singleton ThreadPoolExecutor with max workers equal to the number of CPU cores
run_parallel_tasks: run multiple CPU-bound tasks in parallel using the singleton thread pool executor
submit_future: submit a callable to the thread pool executor and return a Future object
review_thread_pool_singleton: review the thread pool singleton pattern that uses a Lock for thread-safe initialization
refactor_executor_workers: refactor the thread pool executor to use a custom number of workers instead of cpu_count
